verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data-export or account-portability feature, such as a bulk export or an export to CSV/JSON on exit. The REST API, which lets third parties 'access or manipulate configuration data', is a developer building block a user could script an export with, not an export capability itself, so it earns no credit. The CSV feature shown is user import, not export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
